messages:
Irene (Hiring Manager): New PM Noah starts Mon 10am PT. Need a tiny manager one-pager + 30/60/90 to paste into offer email.
Clara (People Ops): Will do 1 short, copy/paste friendly. Include manager commitments?
Irene (Hiring Manager): Yes: weekly 1:1, set a week-1 micro-deliverable, schedule 30/60/90 checkpoints. Also a who-to-ask list.
Dev (IT): IT note: confirm mac/linux + AWS console need. We image 48h before start. If invites fail open @it-help with screenshot. If hardware delayed use cloud devbox: https://devbox.redwood.internal (request via @it-help).
Omar (Buddy): I'm buddy. Can run 30m intro + 1:1 shadow on Day 3. I'll post a short intro in #product.
Clara (People Ops): MANAGER ONE-PAGER (pasteable):
- Pre-boarding: confirm laptop & shipping, personal email for invites, add to Slack channels (#product, #announcements).
- Day 1 AM: 10:00 welcome w/manager (15m), team intros (30m), IT check (15m), lunch w/buddy.
- Day 1 PM: HR benefits (20m), enable Okta/MFA, ensure repo read access, assign 1-week mini deliverable (1-page problem statement).
- Week 1: product demos, customer context, shadow cross-functional partners.
- By day 14: draft 30/60/90 and review with manager.
WHO TO CONTACT: @it-help (IT), @security_ops (Security), @people-ops (Payroll/Benefits), @Omar (Buddy).
30/60/90 (manager prompts):
- 30 days: on-boarded with read access, delivered a scoped onboarding task, met key stakeholders.
- 60 days: own a small feature/experiment, show early metric improvements.
- 90 days: deliver measurable impact tied to OKRs, run planning & demos.
MANAGER COMMITMENTS: weekly 1:1 (30m) for 12 weeks; schedule 30/60/90 checkpoints; provide feedback within 10 business days.
Dev (IT): Grant staging view by Day 2; deploy rights after manager + security signoff. For urgent access open @it-help.
Omar (Buddy): Channel welcome template: "Welcome @Noah! Noah joins as PM Mon 10am PT. Buddy: @Omar. Quick intro 10:30 then lunch." :tada:
Noah (New hire): Thanks! Quick Q: analytics access Day 1?
Dev (IT): View access by Day 2. If you need Day 1, open @it-help and cc your manager.
Irene (Hiring Manager): Clara, one-line offer blurb?
Clara (People Ops): Offer blurb: "Welcome to Redwood! Attached is a short first-week agenda and a starter 30/60/90. We'll provision accounts before Day 1; for setup help contact @it-help. Your buddy @Omar will meet you for lunch on Day 1. Excited to have you aboard!"
Irene (Hiring Manager): Thanks all :rocket:
